title: Lane Slide Activation
description: Defensive slides across the lane and back wake up the hips and groin and prime the stance coaches want to see for the rest of practice.

content.objective: Get into a low defensive stance and move the feet before any live defense is asked for.
content.setup: Players space out along the free-throw line, facing the sideline in a defensive stance.
instructions: Slide from the left elbow to the right elbow and back twice without crossing the feet.
Add two retreat steps backward then two close-out steps forward.
Repeat the whole sequence at a slightly higher tempo.
Finish with five seconds of fast feet in the stance.
coachingPoints: Stay low with the chest up, not the back rounded.
Push off the trail foot; don't let the feet touch.
Keep the hands active, not on the knees.
commonMistakes: Crossing the feet instead of sliding.
Rushing through the movements instead of using the full range of motion.
content.safety: Make sure the floor is clear of bags or balls along the slide path.
